source.title: Larne Times, 12 September 1946, p. 6 ("Carrickfergus News: interest in local elections"); Larne Times, 5 September 1946, p. 5 ("Council elections in East Antrim: Carrickfergus nominations")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'as only three names were put forward for Eden, it meant no contest' / 'In West Central, Mrs Jane Jones ... withdrew her nomination, leaving three candidates, so no contest'; 'Those returned unopposed are' these three (Larne Times, 12 September 1946, p. 6)

note: Whole council elected 18 September 1946 in the new six-ward scheme, three members a ward. West, East, East Central and North Wards were polled (Belfast News-Letter, 19 September 1946); Eden and West Central were uncontested, their three members each returned unopposed (Larne Times, 12 September 1946, p. 6). No party labels are printed for the unopposed members. Robert M'Dowell is described as chairman of Carrickfergus Labour Group and the other West Central and Eden members as Unionists; the labels are not part of the printed return, so none is given. Returned unopposed.
